parts.text: Fig. 1.1 represents a stack of glass microscope slides. A student takes measurements from a stack of glass microscope slides in order to estimate the number of slides in the stack. The sides of the stack have been covered with tape so that the student cannot count the number of slides in the stack. Fig. 1.2 shows side views of the taped stack of slides given to the student. This figure has been drawn at full scale.
